verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair automation question for an email API platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a scheduler, cron-style triggers, or recurring sends. Webhooks and WebSockets are event-driven, one-off reactions to incoming email, not recurring schedules. The Sim integration's workflows belong to a third-party platform, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
